appUnderReview: Your application is being reviewed for three property tax relief programs: Senior Freeze, ANCHOR, and Stay NJ. Each program makes payments on different timelines, and not everyone qualifies for all three programs.
stayPayments: Stay NJ quarterly payments begin February 2027.

noPayment.title: What if I didn't receive a payment yet?
noPayment.content: We are currently processing thousands of applications, and your application could still be processing. To check on the status of a payment, contact the Division:
noPayment.infoCenter: Or visit one of our <1> Regional Information Centers </1>
